d/canyon/canyon2.c.why: stone_forest1.c leads east to canyon2.c, which had no way west and nothing else leads in, so ES2's players never saw the 黄石穿林路, the mirror or the 竹林道 (owner, 天驼关 plan Q1: repaired as a deviation)

兵器库: 喔！那是我们厉害的军师所设的阵法。

lines.line: 二十多年前，先帝将大将军们调来这里驻守隘口。
京城的也就因隘口的巩固而获得安全。
事隔多年，先帝也死了，换上的是位我们不甚认识的小皇帝。
看来他只忙著找剑，也没什么大作为，大家也不太服他。
皇帝看到大将军还要敬畏三分ㄌㄟ。
反正啊，将军和军师是超强的，你可要好好的乌西我们才行。

accept_object.line: 大队长说道:哦喔！还真有心啊，真是谢谢你了。
大队长说道:我已帮你列入名册了，从今天你可自由地出入营区了。
大队长说道:你的诚意不够喔，再多缴点吧。

steps.say: 大胆狂徒，竟私闯此地，给我滚出去

accept_object.say: 即然你那么有心，那我就勉强收起来了。

lines.say: 好极了，我就告诉你一项秘密吧。
在那片光滑的山壁前发誓 我爱.....。
或许你可以发现奇特的事喔。
真是谢谢你了。
为了答谢你，这把古剑送你，当做报酬吧。
你拿给我的是什么东西啊!
别想拿这种东西来骗我
给我滚出去
我已经给你了啊。
那么多钱，那我就没收了:P
我已经给你了啊。
那么多钱，那我就没收了:P
不亏是武林中人，一眼就看出端倪了
这个印鉴就看在钱的份上和你交换了
好吧！即然被你发现了，只好认栽了。
这个真的你就拿去吧

accept_object.say: 你给我这个做什么？我不要，你拿回去吧。

lines.say: 如果是钱的话，我先没收了。
其他的东西我都不要，别再来烦我了。

d/canyon/road.c.set item_desc: a look-only landmark in world.json (canyon.road.landmark.chain), word for word
d/canyon/road.c.function init: climb chain: the act service canyon.road.chain (铁索 · 爬下去)
d/canyon/road.c.function do_climb: service canyon.road.chain: its message_vision(), receive_damage() 20 gin, 30 kee, 10 sen, then the move to canyon1 whatever is left (one taken below zero faints on the heart beat there; asked first when it would, owner's rule on choices that knock out); the tell_room() lines are for the others in canyon1

d/canyon/canyon1.c.set item_desc: a look-only landmark in world.json (canyon.canyon1.landmark.chain), word for word

d/canyon/canyon1.c.function do_climb: service canyon.canyon1.chain: 30 gin, 40 kee, 20 sen, then the move up to road.c, as do_climb() going down

d/canyon/canyon4.c.function init: swear: the act service canyon.canyon4.swear (光滑的山壁 · 发誓：我爱东方故事II, owner: canyon plan Q3), offered only with set_temp 军营/swear (add_action returns 0 for anyone else); its point has no diamond (a secret)
d/canyon/canyon4.c.function do_swear: service canyon.canyon4.swear: set_temp(军营/swear, 0) (clear_temp), the ten message_vision() lines (你 for $N, each in its opening colour) and the move to blackmarket.c (canyon.armory); the oath is the button, so the wrong-words 不要吵 line never comes; the tell_room() lines are for others

d/canyon/canyon5.c.set item_desc: a look-only landmark in world.json (canyon.canyon5.landmark.door), word for word

d/canyon/canyon6.c.set item_desc: a look-only landmark in world.json (canyon.canyon6.landmark.machine): its key is misspelt mechine, so ES2's look machine (the long's word) found nothing; looked at as the long names it (obvious slip, 默认)

d/canyon/camp2.c.set resource/water: world.json services: canyon.camp2.well (kind water: a wineskin is filled at the well)

d/canyon/npc/captain.c.inquiry 黄石隘口: an inquiry rule in set with make: the story told every two seconds (make_stage()); tell_story() returns 0, so ES2 printed ask.c's 没听说过 first, which an answer that acts no longer does (DECISIONS 青石村 B)
d/canyon/npc/captain.c.function tell_story: the inquiry rule's make (NpcMaking without gives): call_out("make_stage", 2, who, 0)
d/canyon/npc/captain.c.function make_stage: NpcMaking: a line to the asker every two seconds, wherever they are; leaving the map tells the rest at once (DECISIONS 晚月庄 C)
d/canyon/npc/captain.c.function accept_object: accept_object rules in set; owner (canyon plan Q2): what the giver paid adds up (tally 军营) until it reaches 3000, ES2 judged each gift alone and kept it; say() lines shown as written (DECISIONS 水烟阁 B); command("grin") prints nothing (no emote daemon)

d/canyon/npc/vice_general.c.function init: greeting in set: one second after the player comes in (the greeting delay), not while he fights
d/canyon/npc/vice_general.c.function greeting: greeting rule in set: one without marks/军营 is told off and moved to camp2 (ob->move(PATH))

d/canyon/npc/general.c.function accept_object: accept_object rules in set: the real 印鉴 (HIY name; the rule names the item, as the two differ only by colour) for the 古剑 (new()'d to the giver); the fake one: three says, set_temp 将军/kick, the move to camp2 (who->move(PATH)) and return 0, so the giver keeps it (a refusal that sets temps and moves); worth nothing → Thank You (grin and smile print nothing)

d/canyon/npc/adviser.c.set mana_factor: only hp.c and score.c read it (a player's own sheet): nothing for an NPC
d/canyon/npc/adviser.c.function accept_object: accept_object rules in set: worth nothing → Thank You (kept); with set_temp 军营/swear → 勉强收起来 (kept); 800 or more → the secret, set_temp 军营/swear; less → 钱太少了吧！没收。 (kept, as he says; DECISIONS 天驼关 A); the command hint (swear) is dropped from the secret (the oath is a button: DECISIONS 水烟阁 B)

d/canyon/npc/seller.c.function accept_object: accept_object rules in set: value() exactly 30000 (3 gold, 300 silver ...) → the fake 印鉴 and set_temp Get_seal, once (after it: 我已经给你了啊, kept, while the player still carries the fake or once he swapped; the flag is saved, so one who lost the fake before the swap buys again, 默认); violate_unique() is defined nowhere in the mudlib (0), so that branch never runs; without his own temp check (an NPC flag, saved) the fake 印鉴 from one 将军/kick → the real one, delete_temp 将军/kick, check set; else 你给我这个做什么 (refused); with check: deviation (owner to decide, 天驼关 B): money is kept as he says (如果是钱的话，我先没收了), the rest refused (ES2 returned 0 for both)

d/canyon/bamboo/bamboo3.c.function init: move stone, enter and go enter: the act services canyon.bamboo3.stone (大黄石 · 推开) and canyon.bamboo3.gap (隙缝 · 进去)
d/canyon/bamboo/bamboo3.c.function do_move: service canyon.bamboo3.stone: below 560 force, 560 max_force or 40 force_factor 你出力不太够喔！; else receive_damage() 20 gin, 60 kee, 20 sen, set("exits/enter") (a room flag, not saved, as doors are not) and its message_vision(); asked first when the cost would knock the player out (owner's rule on such choices); 默认: while the gap is open the stone offers only the way in (ES2's move stone took the cost again and said nothing)
d/canyon/bamboo/bamboo3.c.function do_enter: service canyon.bamboo3.gap, only while the gap is open: delete("exits/enter"), its message_vision() and the move into train.c (canyon.stoneroom)
d/canyon/bamboo/bamboo3.c.function go_enter: go enter: the same as do_enter, the 隙缝 · 进去 button

d/canyon/bamboo/train.c.set item_desc: a look-only landmark in world.json (canyon.train.landmark.bookcase), word for word
d/canyon/bamboo/train.c.function init: search bookcase: the act service canyon.train.bookcase (书柜 · 翻找)
d/canyon/bamboo/train.c.function search_case: service canyon.train.bookcase: while a 悟疾风劲竹书 exists anywhere (F_UNIQUE) 你在书柜找了找但没找到些什么; else the line and a new 书匣 (the book inside). 默认: the room's set_temp("got") is not kept: ES2's clean_up() destructed the empty room and forgot it, so the bookcase gave again later; here it gives again once the book is gone, the same before and after a Continue

d/canyon/bamboo/obj/slipcase.c.statement in create(): object obj: its new(parry_book)->move(this_object()) is contains in set (a new 书匣 holds a 悟疾风劲竹书)
d/canyon/bamboo/obj/slipcase.c.function is_container: a container (max_encumbrance): one lying in reach takes put and get; a carried one shows what it holds, each to take out (get from)

d/canyon/bamboo/obj/parry_book.c.inherit F_UNIQUE: unique in set: F_UNIQUE is not in the mudlib, so parry_book.c did not compile in ES2 (the search failed with it); as the code means (owner, DECISIONS 天驼关 A) only one exists at a time, as 青石村's jade: the bookcase gives none while one exists
